extension.summary: Widgets and lists from your self-hosted Floppy tracker
extension.description: Browse your Floppy (self-hosted media tracker) library from Kodi: Continue Watching, Next Up, Top Picks, Trending, watchlists, history, calendar and your own lists. Every category can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and resume positions are saved back to Floppy.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Settings, Integrations, API Token).
extension.news: 1.3.8: Plays pass the movie's IMDb id (and a show's IMDb and TVDb ids), so sources like Torrentio find it; movies not out to watch at home yet are left out of the TMDb lists (setting in Lists). 1.3.7: Logos TMDb stores as SVG (e.g. Stranger Things) now load: they're fetched as PNG, which Kodi can draw. 1.3.6: Images settings: poster, background, clear logo and episode thumbnail sizes (smaller posters by default) so widget rows load sooner on slow TVs. Artwork fetched in the background now reloads widgets once per batch instead of every 2 seconds. 1.3.5: Path picker lists installed player files with their add-ons' icons, including ones add-ons ship themselves (no TMDb Helper needed). 1.3.4: Genres menu under Discover: popular TMDb movies and shows by category. Genre listings page with page=N. 1.3.3: Genre listing for skins (action=genre): popular movies and shows by TMDb genre, original language or keyword, mixed, for search categories such as skin.ultra's. Uses the TMDb API key in Artwork settings. 1.3.2: Background trailers played by skin.ultra are no longer tracked and don't take a pending play's details. 1.3.0: No longer needs TMDb Helper: play through any add-on with a plugin path (browse add-ons or pick a TMDb Helper-style player file) or a custom URL, with TMDb Helper placeholders and encodings. Playback started outside Floppy, such as from a skin, is tracked and resumed too. Search results carry full tracked state, anime included. Episode lists fill missing plots, runtimes and stills from TMDb. Skins get watchlist status and the show's IMDb id on episodes. Widgets refresh only when Floppy data changes, unless Refresh widgets automatically is on. Playback settings changed: choose your player again under Playback.
